stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 57%/18%, Mr. Action Jackson 79%/41%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 85% / 55%, The Mahomies 32% / 4.9%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 66% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 42%).
🏟️ Game to watch: GB @ LAR (Wednesday 8 PM), 1 league starters in action with 17.05 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Wednesday 8 PM (GB @ LAR): Golden for The Mahomies.
⚠️ ELIMINATION WATCH: Gibb it to Me Baby could be officially out of the race for a playoff spot as soon as next week.
📝 REPORT CARDS ARE OUT: Brock You Like a Hurricane A (scoring A+, record A+); Kirbo Crushers D- (record F, scoring F).
📰 Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high-pressure' situation for Commanders. That's TDsMaGee's starting QB. Take note.
🔁 Retro trade: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped McMillan for Skattebo and Andrews back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
